description: Layer 4: agent assignment. This is the ONLY place a role is bound to a deployment. Changing an assignment here changes active role, activated skills, and matching tool permissions together; it changes no shared-runtime, toolkit, or role-pack bytes.

assignments.assignmentReason: initial assignment; Ptah is the intended default repair worker

invariants: an agent that is compatible but unassigned holds no service authority
qualification binds agent identity, role-pack version, toolkit version, runtime version and deployment profile
reassignment is one transaction over role, skills, permissions and qualification state
